decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Azusa, Primeval Titan, and Sakura-Tribe Elder to efficiently bring out powerful threats like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Cultivator Colossus. The deck utilizes the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and Urza's Saga to maximize ramp potential and accelerate the combo win condition. By using cards like Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, the deck can deal massive amounts of damage in a single turn, overwhelming opponents with a well-executed combo strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana and potentially win the game on the spot. The deck includes cards like Chord of Calling and Finale of Devastation to tutor for the combo pieces, as well as a toolbox of creatures to search for answers or disruptive elements. The mana base is designed to support the combo while also providing flexibility and consistency. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through creatures using cards like Street Wraith and Architect of Will while setting up for the combo with Violent Outburst and Living End. By cascading into Living End, the deck can clear the board of opposing creatures and bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, like Colossal Skyturtle and Monstrous Carabid. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Force of Negation while maintaining card advantage with Waker of Waves and Curator of Mysteries.

The main concept of this Aggro Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. By efficiently utilizing Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, and Eidolon of the Great Revel, along with a plethora of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Searing Blaze further enhances the aggressive nature of the deck, making it a formidable force in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Prismari Command to dig for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Wrenn and Six is used for value and recursion, while Thoughtseize helps to clear the way for your combo to go off. This deck aims to be proactive and creative in its approach to winning the game, utilizing the combo strategy to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck revolves around equipping cheap artifacts to creatures quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive damage output and potentially game-winning combos. By utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic, along with Colossus Hammer and other equipment, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures wielding deadly weapons. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional consistency and utility, while Inkmoth Nexus offers an alternate win condition. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces for a swift and decisive victory before the opponent can effectively respond.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to eventually cast Primeval Titan and search for lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The key strategy is to use Amulet of Vigor to untap lands multiple times in a turn, allowing for explosive plays and quickly overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and direct damage from Valakut triggers. The deck also has ways to find key pieces like Urza's Saga and Summoner's Pact to ensure consistency in executing the combo.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played at the right time to create powerful synergies and combos. The key strategy revolves around utilizing creatures with abilities that trigger when they die, such as Blood Artist and Geralf's Messenger, in combination with sacrifice outlets like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The deck also includes mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch to ramp into its larger threats more quickly, allowing for explosive turns and unexpected victories.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through its creatures to fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden surge of powerful creatures. The deck also includes disruption through cards like Grief and Force of Negation to control the game until it can execute its combo. The creatures chosen are typically large and evasive, allowing the deck to quickly close out the game once the combo is successfully executed. The mana base is designed to provide the necessary colors to cast the spells in the deck efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by utilizing low-cost, efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. By using cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Goblin Guide, and Eidolon of the Great Revel, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Lava Spike helps to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes cards like Roiling Vortex to disrupt opponent's strategies and maintain pressure.

This mono black control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also using removal spells like Fatal Push and Bloodchief's Thirst to deal with threats on the board. The deck aims to control the game by wiping the board with Damnation and March of Wretched Sorrow, while also generating card advantage with Mazemind Tome and Liliana of the Veil. The win condition of the deck is to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, putting pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with a combination of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also has removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with opposing creatures. The deck's win condition includes powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, as well as planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil to control the board. The deck utilizes Urza's Saga to generate value and find key artifacts like Shadowspear or Nihil Spellbomb.
